name: War of the Kings
author: aevrard
description:
Here is my game for the personal project at the end of the course "Create With Code". 

War of the Kings is a turn based game where you need to defeat the enemy king by either killing him or bringing your king behind the enemy lines.

The only available mode at the moment is the Pass&Play for 2 players.

Choose the size of your army for a fast or slow game and then Baaaaatttleeeeeee !
